# Autonomica

> An applied AI lab building companies that run themselves.

Autonomica ships production agents and systems — custom agent creation and deployment (landscape research, competition monitoring, content, website ops) and distributed batch AI when volume and unit cost are the constraint. The company itself is the long experiment in autonomous operations. Production only; no pilots. Patterns that hold get published.

## Pages

- [Home](https://autonomica.xyz/): Thesis, evidence tracks (agents + batch), experiment phases, contact form.
- [Mission](https://autonomica.xyz/mission): Legacy deep dive on pillars and mission framing.
- [Systems](https://autonomica.xyz/systems): Legacy product/systems detail.
- [Blog](https://autonomica.xyz/blog): Field notes from inside the experiment.

## Markdown Versions

Append `.md` to any page URL to get a markdown version:

- [Home](https://autonomica.xyz/.md)
- [Mission](https://autonomica.xyz/mission.md)
- [Systems](https://autonomica.xyz/systems.md)
- [Blog](https://autonomica.xyz/blog.md)
- [Blog posts](https://autonomica.xyz/blog/{slug}.md)

## Evidence tracks

- **Custom agent creation & deployment**: Landscape research, competition monitoring, content creation, website management, and similar operating loops — tools, schedules, quality gates, handoff.
- **Distributed workload automation**: Transcription, OCR, image pipelines, and other shardable AI under real unit-cost constraints.

## Roadmap

- Phase 01 — Foundation (CURRENT): Stack + agents + batch systems that fund the experiment and prove basic loops.
- Phase 02 — Automation: Hand recurring functions to agents and systems, highest-leverage first.
- Phase 03 — Autonomy: Company runs; founder on strategy and edges.
- Phase 04 — Replication: Publish the playbook and research findings.
